symptom: deploy-misconfig flags two legitimate patterns as hard-coded local URLs: (1) env-backed defaults like process.env.X ?? "http://localhost:8000" — the exact remediation the rule suggests; (2) test-tooling files (playwright.config.ts, e2e/*, capture scripts) where a localhost target is the point, not a defect.
evidence: Scanning six real earlier repos produced 30+ deploy-misconfig hits, nearly all this pattern: entrega-clara app/web/next.config.ts `API_INTERNAL_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000"` (documented as intended design in that repo's AGENTS.md), evalforge frontend/src/lib/api.ts `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8200"`, WCP apps/*/src/config.ts zod `.default("http://localhost:8000")`, policydesk web/playwright.config.ts baseURL.
root_cause: The rule flags every http(s) URL literal matching localhost/http without checking whether it is already behind an env lookup, and it scans test-tooling files it should skip.
notes: Found while scanning real repos for the case-study hunt — the scanner's own false positives are registered before fixing, per the issue-register rule.
